title: Off-Cycle Investment Intern
description: We are a pre-seed and seed fund investing in B2B software across Europe. The off-cycle intern will support sourcing, run first-call screens with founders, and build market maps. You will sit with the investment team and own your own pipeline. Previous off-cycle interns have gone on to analyst roles with us.

title: Summer Analyst Programme 2027
description: Our flagship summer programme for penultimate-year students. Ten weeks across our growth equity and buyout teams, with a structured training week and a return-offer decision at the end.

title: Venture Capital Intern (Off-Cycle)
description: Seed-stage fund backing developer tools. Applicants must have existing US work authorisation; we are unable to sponsor visas for this position. You will run technical diligence on infrastructure companies and write investment memos.

title: Investment Intern, Deep Tech
description: Six-month off-cycle placement with a pre-seed deep tech fund. You will assess technical founders' claims, read papers, and run diligence alongside our technical partners. Some Python for data work on our portfolio dashboard.

title: Graduate Analyst Scheme
description: Two-year rotational graduate scheme across public equities research and portfolio construction. Open to final-year students graduating in 2027.

title: Investment Team Intern
description: We are looking for an intern to join our investment team. Early-stage focus. Get in touch with a CV and a note on what you find interesting in European software.
